decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive dependency of commons-text:1.9, recorded in gradle.lockfile but not declared in build.gradle. Minimum fix is 3.18.0 (3.x minor bump, not major). Bumping commons-text only to 1.10.0 leaves lang3 at 3.12.0 and does not resolve this CVE; bump commons-text to ≥ 1.14.0 (brings lang3 3.18.0 transitively) and run ./gradlew dependencies --write-locks, or add an explicit implementation 'org.apache.commons:commons-lang3:3.18.0' plus lock refresh. No direct application usage of lang3; ClassUtils.getClass StackOverflow risk is only relevant if untrusted input reaches those APIs elsewhere in the dependency tree.

decisions.reason: CRITICAL patch/minor bump 1.9 → 1.10.0
decisions.notes: Direct implementation dependency in build.gradle. Minimum fix is 1.10.0 (1.x minor bump, not major), which disables script/dns/url default interpolators. TokenTemplate uses new StringSubstitutor(values) and deliberately avoids StringSubstitutor.createInterpolator(), so runtime RCE exposure is already mitigated in app code, but the dependency should still be upgraded. Change the version in build.gradle and refresh gradle.lockfile via ./gradlew dependencies --write-locks; consider bumping to ≥ 1.14.0 in the same change to also pull commons-lang3 ≥ 3.18.0 transitively.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Declared directly in pom.xml with an explicit version (not transitive or BOM-managed). Highest scanner-listed fix is 2.26.1 (2.25.5 also fixes). Low practical exploitability here: CVE-2026-49844 requires JsonTemplateLayout message resolver or MapMessage.asJson() paths; this app uses PatternLayout Console appenders only. Bump the existing pom.xml <version> pin and keep log4j-api aligned with log4j-core.

decisions.reason: CRITICAL patch/minor bump 2.14.1 → 2.26.1
decisions.notes: Declared directly in pom.xml with an explicit version (not transitive or BOM-managed). Highest scanner-listed core fixes are 2.25.4 (TLS hostname verification, XmlLayout sanitization) and 2.17.1 (JDBC appender JNDI); recommending 2.26.1 keeps api/core aligned and supersedes all listed minimums. CRITICAL Log4Shell CVEs are fully reachable in default 2.14.1 configs with attacker-controlled log/MDC input. log4j2.xml comment already anticipates 2.15+ %msg lookup behavior change—retest console and audit PatternLayout output after upgrade. JDBC/Socket/SMTP/Syslog TLS and XmlLayout CVEs are low risk with current Console+PatternLayout config but still require upgrade. Fix by bumping the pom.xml version pin; no BOM or lockfile refresh path exists in this repo.

decisions.reason: CRITICAL patch/minor bump 5.3.1 → 5.4
decisions.notes: Explicit pin in requirements.txt. CVE-2020-14343 affects FullLoader/full_load on untrusted YAML; risk_scoring/config.py uses yaml.safe_load on an operator-supplied rules file, so the vulnerable code path is not exercised, but the installed package version remains flagged. Bump the requirements.txt pin to >=5.4 (minor bump within the 5.x line); no transitive parent to refresh.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Explicit pin in requirements.txt. Highest fix across four MEDIUM CVEs is 2.33.0. risk_scoring/client.py uses a one-off requests.get with timeout (no Session, proxy auth, .netrc, or extract_zipped_paths), reducing practical exposure to proxy/.netrc/cert-pool/extract_zipped_paths issues, but the dependency should still be bumped. Update the requirements.txt pin to >=2.33.0; stays within 2.x and should be low blast radius for current usage.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via gatsby, gatsby-cli; bump direct deps (gatsby, gatsby-cli) and run npm install to refresh package-lock.json. Rebuild required after Babel toolchain upgrade.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via spring-boot-starter-logging (pulled in by all starters). Managed by the Spring Boot BOM. Boot 3.5.15 ships Logback 1.5.34, well above the 1.5.19 fix. Exploit requires Janino + Spring on the classpath and write access to logback config; low practical risk for this app but trivial to patch via BOM upgrade.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via spring-boot-starter-json and jackson-databind. BOM-managed. GHSA-r7wm supersedes the incomplete 2.18.6/2.21.1 fix; 2.21.4 is the correct target on the 2.x line. Boot 3.5.15 BOM already pins jackson-bom 2.21.4. Async-parser DoS only affects non-blocking parser paths (WebFlux streaming decode); this MVC app has lower exposure but should still upgrade.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via spring-boot-starter-json / spring-boot-docker-compose (test). BOM-managed. Most CVEs fix at 2.21.4, but CVE-2026-54515 requires 2.21.5 or 2.22.1 — use 2.22.1 and align jackson-core to the same BOM version. Boot 3.5.15 only provides 2.21.4, so add a `<jackson-bom.version>2.22.1</jackson-bom.version>` property override (Maven) or equivalent Gradle ext property.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set

Only used when PostgreSQL profile is active.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set

decisions.notes: Direct require in go-gin/go.mod; imported in main.go for CORS middleware. App uses an explicit AllowOrigins allowlist without wildcards, reducing practical exploitability of the wildcard-origin parsing bug, but the vulnerable middleware is still loaded. Bump the go.mod require to v1.6.0 and run go mod tidy.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Direct require in go-gin/go.mod; used across routes and controllers. CVE affects Context.FileAttachment filename sanitization; codebase does not call FileAttachment, so runtime risk is low. Patch bump to v1.9.1 via go.mod + go mod tidy is low blast radius.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Direct require in go-gin/go.mod; used for MongoDB CRUD in configs and controllers. App authenticates with SCRAM-SHA-256, not GSSAPI/Kerberos CGo bindings, so the heap OOB read in GSSAPI code is likely not reachable in this deployment. Still a significant minor-line jump (1.11→1.17); bump go.mod require and run go mod tidy, then regression-test BSON/API usage.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Indirect (// indirect) in go-gin/go.mod; pulled by github.com/gin-gonic/gin, github.com/go-playground/validator/v10, and go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver. Most CVEs target golang.org/x/crypto/ssh and ssh/agent; this HTTP API does not appear to use SSH directly, limiting practical exposure. Highest fix across all findings is v0.56.0. Parent bumps alone may not reach that minimum; use go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.56.0 and go mod tidy.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Indirect in go-gin/go.mod; pulled by github.com/gin-gonic/gin and golang.org/x/crypto. HTTP/2 DoS CVEs (CVE-2023-39325, CVE-2023-45288, CVE-2026-33814) are most relevant to the Gin HTTP server; html/idna/dns CVEs are less relevant unless those subpackages are used directly. Highest fix is v0.56.0. Explicit go get golang.org/x/net@v0.56.0 recommended after parent upgrades.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Indirect in go-gin/go.mod; pulled by gin, validator, x/net, x/crypto, and github.com/xdg-go/stringprep (mongo-driver). CVE affects norm.Iter infinite loop on invalid UTF-8; exposure depends on whether validation/normalization paths process untrusted UTF-8. Fix via go get golang.org/x/text@v0.39.0 and go mod tidy.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Indirect in go-gin/go.mod; pulled by github.com/gin-gonic/gin for protojson/JSON handling. DoS via infinite loop in protojson.Unmarshal on malformed JSON with Any fields or DiscardUnknown; indirect exposure through Gin JSON stack. Fix via go get google.golang.org/protobuf@v1.33.0 or by upgrading gin if its newer release raises the minimum.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set

decisions.reason: CRITICAL patch/minor bump 4.0.0 → 4.0.6

Fix via axios upgrade + npm install lockfile refresh to 4.0.6.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive dev dependency via postcss (postcss ^3.3.4 in package-lock.json); postcss is pulled by @vue/cli-service and other build plugins, not declared directly in package.json. Build-time only; DoS/predictable-ID CVEs require attacker-controlled size inputs to nanoid APIs. Stay on 3.x line (3.3.18) to avoid major jump to 5.x. Fix via npm update postcss (which will pull nanoid) or lockfile refresh.

decisions.reason: severity HIGH is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive dev/build dependency locked in package-lock.json; required by @vue/cli-service (~5.0.0) and css tooling with peer ranges ^8.x that permit 8.5.23. Source-map/path-traversal and XSS CVEs apply only when processing untrusted CSS at build time. Not in package.json; fix via npm update postcss and lockfile refresh within the existing Vue CLI 5 toolchain (no postcss major bump needed).

decisions.reason: CRITICAL patch/minor bump 1.2.5 → 1.2.6
decisions.notes: Direct dependency in package.json (dependencies.minimist: 1.2.5); sole lockfile entry at node_modules/minimist. Used via require('minimist') in src/cli.js and test/checkout.test.js for standard CLI option parsing (string/boolean flags, aliases, defaults). 1.2.5 → 1.2.6 is a patch fix for prototype pollution in setKey(); semver-compatible and low risk for this usage. Fix by setting minimist to 1.2.6 in package.json and running npm install to refresh package-lock.json.
